events.text: The United States Constitution is signed in Philadelphia.
Battle of Antietam, the bloodiest single day of the American Civil War.
Thomas Selfridge becomes the first person killed in a powered aeroplane crash, flying with Orville Wright.
The American Professional Football Association, later the NFL, is founded.
NASA unveils the Space Shuttle Enterprise.
Egypt and Israel sign the Camp David Accords.
Vanessa Williams becomes the first Black woman crowned Miss America.
The Occupy Wall Street protest begins in New York.

births.text: Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of India
